name: Flat Design

name: Material Design

name: Neumorphism (Soft UI)
whereToUse: Smart home thermostats, audio/media players, minimalist calculators, concept showcase widgets.

cssSnippet:
background: #E0E5EC; border-radius: 20px;
box-shadow: 8px 8px 16px #A3B1C6, -8px -8px 16px #FFFFFF;

name: Glassmorphism

name: Claymorphism

aiPrompt: Create a Claymorphic wellness app screen with puffy pastel rounded cards, double inner shadows for 3D squishiness, and friendly rounded sans-serif text.

name: Bento UI (Bento Grid)

name: Aurora UI (Mesh Gradient)
